newsitem.title: CHINA: China stock exchanges give 1997 holiday dates.
newsitem.headline: China stock exchanges give 1997 holiday dates.

text.p: China's two stock exchanges will halt trading for two weeks from February 3 to February 14 over the Chinese lunar new year holiday, the Shanghai Securities newspaper said on Tuesday.

The newspaper, in a list of 1997 trading holiday dates, said the exchanges in Shanghai and Shenzhen will also halt trading on January 1, May Day on May 1 and over China's National Day holiday from October 1 to October 3.
Trading in Shenzhen B shares will also be suspended on Hong Kong's public holidays, it added.
